mutations.name: the naming hint quotes every sentence of its beats
kills: the naming-refrain repair hint quotes the naming lines with their beats and none of the filler

mutations.name: the named-before-defined hint swaps the speaking and declaring beats
mutations.find: is spoken in ${spokenIn} but declared in ${declaredIn}
mutations.replace: is spoken in ${declaredIn} but declared in ${spokenIn}
kills: the named-before-defined repair hint names the term, the beat that speaks it and the beat that declares it, and moving the declaration to the speaking beat passes

mutations.name: the short-register hint swaps the measured mean and the floor
kills: the short-register repair hint states the measured mean and the 12-word floor, and joining the short sentences into longer ones passes
